## CRAM / palette routing

Genesis has 4 CRAM palettes × 16 colors = 64 slots. Layout post-Phase-B/F:

- **BG**: pixel-bias in PAL0 (4 sub-pals packed in 16 colors)
- **SPR_sub_pal_0**: OAM pal=PAL1, tile pixel values 1..3
- **SPR_sub_pal_1**: OAM pal=PAL2, tile pixel values 1..3
- **SPR_sub_pal_2**: OAM pal=PAL3, tile pixel values 1..3
- **SPR_sub_pal_3**: clamped to sub-pal 2 (NES sprite census shows minimal use; deferred to Phase N)

## OAM slot ownership (slots 0..10+)

Genesis SAT has 80 slots in H32 mode. Slots 0..9 are gameplay-owned (player + items + projectiles); slots 10..63 are the enemy bridge. Each slot has exactly ONE owner. Constants in `src/game/world/render/sprite_slots.h`.
